locked_rules: Sportsbook prices, odds, spread, total, implied probability, ADP and ECR may not influence canonical football state or any football forecast.
Market comparison is downstream only and may consume football forecasts after they are produced.
A canonical evidence key may receive numeric authority in at most one layer unless an explicit decomposition documents non-overlapping effects.
Rejected, quarantined and zero-authority modules may not change projections, ranks, True Value, market verdicts, fair lines or probabilities.
The unified reason stack is read-only and may not mutate upstream outputs.
Missing evidence remains unknown, not zero.
Season-long player numerics remain unchanged because no validated weekly-to-season aggregation bridge exists.
All 162 authoritative fantasy players must remain unique and represented exactly once.
Full backward audit is the next promotion gate and remains required before any Step 6.5 promotion or merge.
